title: MagicBricks + 99acres Property Scraper Input
description: Run the prefilled Mumbai search for one clean property, or paste a filtered MagicBricks/99acres results URL. Residential India proxy is preselected for reliable access.

source.title: Property portal
source.description: For the quickest first run, keep MagicBricks. Choose Both only when you intentionally want results from two portals.
source.sectionDescription: Ready to run as-is: one Mumbai sale listing from MagicBricks. Change only what you need.

transactionType.title: Looking for
transactionType.description: Choose sale listings or rental listings.

cities.title: Indian cities
cities.description: Start with one city. Examples: Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Delhi, Chennai, or Hyderabad.

maxResults.title: Maximum properties
maxResults.description: Start with 1 to verify the output and cost. Increase only when you are ready to collect more properties.

searchUrls.title: MagicBricks or 99acres search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional. Paste complete search-results URLs to preserve the portal's locality, BHK, property type, furnishing, budget, and posted-by filters. When supplied, these URLs override the quick-start portal, transaction, and city fields.
searchUrls.sectionDescription: Already filtered results on MagicBricks or 99acres? Paste the full URL here and the Actor will keep those filters while paginating.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (INR)
minPrice.description: Optional minimum price. Leave empty for the first run. Listings without a published price are skipped when this filter is active.
minPrice.sectionDescription: Apply after a successful sample run. Values are Indian rupees, not lakhs or crores.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (INR)
maxPrice.description: Optional maximum price. Leave empty for the first run. Listings without a published price are skipped when this filter is active.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential India proxy is preselected because both portals commonly reject datacenter traffic.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Keep the recommended setting unless you already have a reliable Indian proxy.
